<!--
One box. Nothing below is a required field, and nothing here is published.

This is a legacy Markdown issue template on purpose: only `.md` templates
honour a `?body=` query parameter, and the site's /suggest page prefills this
body with whatever the visitor typed. An issue *form* (`.yml`) cannot prefill
the body — it accepts only template/title/labels/assignees — so using a form
here would silently discard their text on the way over.

What happens next: a bot replies with what it understood (entry, field,
proposed value, source), and asks you to confirm. Reply "yes" and it is
queued. Reply with a correction and it re-reads you. Nothing is applied
until you confirm, and a misreading costs you one word, not a resubmission.
-->
